cover_letter_text:
Please accept my application for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role advertised on JobsNext. The advert asks for an Advanced Diploma in Civil Construction Design and drafting of roads, drainage, subdivisions and earthworks, which is exactly what I have just trained in.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against them on site and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, so I know how drawings are used once they leave the office.

My drafting experience so far comes from my studies rather than a paid drafting role, and I would be keen to learn your drawing standards and procedures. I live in Melton, hold an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.

I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
